subject: groupclade function does not preserve the features from .nhx file

messages.author: 4277004cf972e0df
messages.subject: groupclade function does not preserve the features from .nhx file
parts:
Hi,
I am trying to color few edges in a tree. I doing it by grouping the clades. However, as soon as I pass the tree file thrugh the groupclade function, the features such as bootstrap and others are lost. How to use the groupclade function without loosing the features.
For example:
the trial.nhx file contains:
(((ADH2:0.1[&&NHX:S=human], ADH1:0.11[&&NHX:S=human]):
0.05 [&&NHX:S=primates:D=Y:B=100],ADHY:
0.1[&&NHX:S=nematode],ADHX:0.12 [&&NHX:S=insect]):
0.1[&&NHX:S=metazoa:D=N],(ADH4:0.09[&&NHX:S=yeast],
ADH3:0.13[&&NHX:S=yeast], ADH2:0.12[&&NHX:S=yeast],
ADH1:0.11[&&NHX:S=yeast]):0.1[&&NHX:S=Fungi])[&&NHX:D=N];
#reading the tree
tree <- read.nhx("./trial.nhx")
tree2 <- groupClade(tree, c(10,11 ))
p= ggtree(tree2,aes(color=group))+
geom_label(aes(x=branch, label=S), fill='lightgreen')
p
This fails to make any tree because of loss of feature S.

Could you help me resolve this?

messages.author: 2a4584b898b0bd00
messages.subject: Re: groupclade function does not preserve the features from .nhx file
parts: This is a bug and it has been fixed in treeio v >= 1.18.1.
On Sat, Apr 10, 2021 at 7:06 AM Boominathan Mohanasundaram <boo...@gmail.com> wrote:

Sorry to bother. I figured it out.
My current code as follows:
library(tidyverse)
tree <- read.nhx("./trial.nhx")
pre_tree <- ggtree(tree)
rescue_data <- pre_tree %>% select(node,B,D,S)
tree2 <- groupClade(tree, c(10,11 ))
p= ggtree(tree2,aes(color=group))%<+% rescue_data+
geom_label(aes(x=branch, label=S), fill='lightgreen')
p
